evidence.source: issue-291 controlled local qualification and accepted Policy Search pilot operating limits
evidence.limitation: These values qualify the accepted pilot limits for bounded Dashboard workloads; they are not production SLOs or full-service capacity evidence. Idle, zero in-flight age, refreshed visibility and broker offsets do not prove caught-up status or completeness. Shared Alloy failure and backlog remain shared infrastructure health.

DashboardServiceErrorRate.suppression: Fewer than 20 requests or only success/invalid_request outcomes.
DashboardServiceErrorRate.recovery: The five-minute unexpected-error ratio returns to 10% or lower.
DashboardServiceErrorRate.response: Split failures by transport and status, inspect safe logs/traces, and verify Elasticsearch readiness, TLS and reader privileges before rollback.

DashboardHighLatency.recovery: The five-minute request p95 returns to 250ms or lower.
DashboardHighLatency.response: Split latency by transport and inspect Elasticsearch duration and a representative trace.

DashboardElasticsearchFailure.recovery: The five-minute dependency failure ratio returns to 5% or lower.
DashboardElasticsearchFailure.response: Split Dashboard read failures by operation and outcome and verify Elasticsearch readiness, TLS and reader privileges.

DashboardElasticsearchHighLatency.recovery: The five-minute dependency p95 returns to 250ms or lower.
DashboardElasticsearchHighLatency.response: Split Dashboard read latency by operation, inspect Elasticsearch health and correlate a slow trace.

DashboardEventFailure.suppression: Fewer than 10 completed registrations, healthy idle or a disabled worker.
DashboardEventFailure.recovery: The five-minute malformed/error/cancelled ratio returns to 10% or lower.
DashboardEventFailure.response: Inspect bounded registration outcomes and writer/Kafka readiness without exposing event values.

DashboardEventStalled.suppression: Worker enabled is zero or in-flight age is zero.
DashboardEventStalled.recovery: Completion or cancellation resets in-flight age to zero.
DashboardEventStalled.response: Inspect writer/Kafka readiness and a correlated trace, preserving offsets before restart or rollback.

DashboardEventCommitFailure.suppression: No registration offset commit failure occurred in five minutes.
DashboardEventCommitFailure.recovery: The last commit failure ages out of the five-minute window.
DashboardEventCommitFailure.response: Inspect bounded commit diagnostics and broker readiness while preserving offset and document evidence.

DashboardResourcePressure.suppression: Both CPU and memory remain at or below 80% of their deployment limits.
DashboardResourcePressure.recovery: Both resource signals remain below their thresholds.
DashboardResourcePressure.response: Inspect Dashboard request load, runtime memory, throttling, pod events and rollout identity.

DashboardUnavailable.recovery: The deployment returns to its desired available replica count.
DashboardUnavailable.response: Inspect rollout, readiness, configuration, Elasticsearch assignment before rollback.

DashboardTelemetryMissing.suppression: The deployment is unavailable or runtime samples are present.
DashboardTelemetryMissing.recovery: A bounded Go runtime sample resumes.
DashboardTelemetryMissing.response: Verify OTLP configuration, Alloy receiver and remote-write health before changing the rule.

DashboardTelemetryDeliveryFailure.suppression: Delivery failure/drop counters do not increase; missing exporter series do not fabricate failure.
DashboardTelemetryDeliveryFailure.recovery: All five-minute failure/drop increases return to zero.
DashboardTelemetryDeliveryFailure.response: Identify the failed signal/backend and inspect bounded retry/drop counters while preserving service availability.

DashboardTelemetryBacklog.suppression: No samples are pending and exporter queue use is 80% or lower; absent series do not fabricate backlog.
DashboardTelemetryBacklog.recovery: Pending samples clear and exporter queues return to 80% or lower.
DashboardTelemetryBacklog.response: Check backend reachability and Alloy queue/WAL health, then verify recovery within two minutes.

DashboardUnexpectedRestart.suppression: No container restart occurred in 15 minutes.
DashboardUnexpectedRestart.recovery: The last restart ages out of the 15-minute window.
DashboardUnexpectedRestart.response: Inspect prior state, safe logs, pod events, resource pressure and rollout identity.
